title: Patch Notes
summary: A second set of eyes for your next pull request.

cover.alt: Illustrative Patch Notes interface for this fictional project

screenshots.alt: Detail of the fictional Patch Notes workspace, labeled as a design preview

story.problem: Reviewing unfamiliar code is hard when the reason for a change is buried in the diff.
story.built: A review workspace that places a plain-language explanation beside the lines that support it.
story.aiUse: Codex helps draft a change summary from a bounded diff. Every claim links back to the source.
story.humanDecisions: I designed the evidence format, limited what context reaches the model, and checked misleading summaries against small test cases.
story.limitations: This sample illustrates small Python changes. It does not approve code or replace a human reviewer.
